name: Three Panel Transition
description: Three rising shutters with staggered timing and an independent image entrance.

settings.label: Play on entry
settings.description: Replay the entrance on mount and settings changes. Disable for manually triggered navigation.

settings.label: Transition label
settings.description: Overlay word, limited to 12 characters. Use a short word for a clean fit.

settings.label: Heading
settings.description: Demo headline. Line breaks are preserved; custom React children own their own copy.

settings.label: Caption
settings.default:
Good things begin with a little movement.
Give your next idea a memorable entrance.
settings.description: Demo supporting copy. Custom React children own their own copy.

settings.label: Canvas
settings.description: Receiving canvas behind the demo image. Visible while the image loads or wherever content leaves the canvas uncovered.

settings.label: Text
settings.description: Base color for the demo headline, supporting copy and credit. The replay action and overlay labels use their own colors.

settings.label: Minimum height
settings.description: Minimum receiving area height in pixels. The layout follows its container width.

settings.label: Shutter travel
settings.description: Travel time in milliseconds for each shutter and the centered label. Entry delay, Covered hold and Panel stagger add to the complete sequence.

settings.label: Navigation cover
settings.description: Outgoing cover duration in milliseconds. Applies to Next scene, cover() and navigate(), not Replay reveal.

settings.label: Panel stagger
settings.description: Delay in milliseconds between successive shutters starting their upward travel. The label starts with the first shutter.

settings.label: Covered hold
settings.description: Covered pause in milliseconds after Entry delay, before the first shutter and label move.

settings.label: Entry delay
settings.description: Initial reveal delay in milliseconds. Navigation cover uses its separate duration.

settings.label: Motion curve
settings.description: Curve shared by the three shutters and centered label. Image rise retains its independently tuned curve.

settings.label: Shutter cover
settings.description: Fill shared by all three shutters and their seam strips.

settings.label: Shutter mark
settings.description: Color of the centered label on the shutters.

settings.label: Shutter corner radius
settings.description: Shutter corner radius in pixels.

settings.label: Shutter mark travel
settings.description: Distance in pixels travelled by the label as the first shutter opens.

settings.label: Image rise
settings.description: Image starts this many pixels lower. Set to 0 to disable. Custom media opts in with data-pt-image.

settings.label: Image settle duration
settings.description: Image entrance duration in milliseconds; active when Image rise is greater than 0.

settings.label: Image start offset
settings.description: Image start offset in milliseconds after the first panel; active when Image rise is greater than 0.
